title: Middle of Linked List
description: Find the middle node of a singly linked list using the slow-fast pointer technique.

data.text: Given `head`, return the middle node of the linked list. If there are two middle nodes, return the second one.

data.title: Two-Pass O(2n) O(1)
Single Pass O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: Counting first forces you to walk the entire list before moving toward the middle. The slow-fast method lets both pointers advance at the same time: when the fast pointer reaches the end, the slow pointer has naturally arrived at the middle. Only one pass is needed.

cards.title: Count Then Walk
cards.description: Count nodes, then advance to midpoint

cards.title: Slow-Fast Pointer
cards.description: Fast moves twice as fast as slow
